## Sources (how this label entered the ledger)

Introduces the hierarchy Soul>Buddhi>Manas>Indriya>Objects, refining Kernel~Mind into Kernel~Manas+Buddhi operational system (two distinct functions, Manas=state-processing, Buddhi=discrimination). Gives a control-loop model W_t->O_t->M_t->B_t->A_t->K_{t+1}. From the false-agency verse (3.27), proposes 'Kernel must distinguish operation from operator' — the system must not confuse 'I produced this result' with 'this operation produced this result under these conditions', with strong implications for provenance/attribution/auditability. Proposes a kernel safety invariant Buddhi(x) != Buddhi(x|unexamined attachment), i.e. Discern->CheckBias->Qualify->Decide, explicitly not proof of the Qualify operator, only motivation. Major refinement: Zero(K_t) = Missingness + Distortion, Z_t=(G_t,D_t) (ignorance vs corruption of already-present but distorted knowledge) — flagged as requiring a corpus test before adoption. Gives Svadharma->Operation applicability subset Type(OperationContext), connecting to the existing Admissible concept. Proposes progressive-not-destructive knowledge transformation (detect misconception->introduce evidence->discriminate->reconcile->transition, not delete-and-replace). Gives a 12-operator candidate catalogue and a candidate kernel state (fraktur K)_t=(M_t,B_t,K_t,Sigma_t,G_t,D_t,Gamma_t) with transition algebra. Closes proposing a Cross-chapter Kernel Reconciliation matrix."
